items.t: Tsawwassen Central is the ground around the junction of 56 Street and 12 Avenue in Tsawwassen, City of Delta, and the City publishes no boundary for the name.
The centre's landmark site is Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall, whose City-listed addresses are 1219 56 Street, 5499 12 Avenue and 1236 55 Street
Tsawwassen Library is at 1321A 56 St on the mall site, and South Delta Recreation Centre is at 1720 56 St beside South Delta Exchange

The centre's housing is freehold detached and duplex houses under the RS and RD zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, on in-town lots — subdivision minimums run from RS7 at 335 m² and RS6 at 390 m² up to RD1 at 836 m².

items.t: Status (as of November 3, 2026): the original rezoning application (October 2024) proposed about 1,433 homes; a revised, reduced application (September 2025, about 600 homes) was rejected by Delta Council on October 6, 2025, per the developer's own project updates page — the project is not approved

Southlands Tsawwassen — Century Group; sales centre at #101 – 6388 Market Ave. Status (as of November 3, 2026): under construction and selling in phases; the developer states about 950 freehold homes at completion, home sales began in 2020, and full build-out is expected to take about 10 to 15 years, around a Market District anchored by Market Square and the Red Barn
Century Group's own project page describes Southlands as 950 homes on 537 acres along Boundary Bay, with working farmland, forest and trails connecting to Boundary Bay Park
South Delta Exchange is the transit hub, at 56 Street and 18 Avenue beside South Delta Recreation Centre: routes 601 and 602 run from the exchange area to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line)

faq.a: No — it is a Paragon sub-area name. The official planning framework is the Tsawwassen community under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), a single consolidated plan, and no official City boundary exists for the name.
faq.q: Is Tsawwassen Central an official City of Delta neighbourhood?

faq.a: Yes — the Tsawwassen Urban Centre is a Development Permit Area under the Official Community Plan, with guidelines in Appendix B of Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) covering siting, streetscape, massing and landscaping.
faq.q: Do development rules treat the town centre differently?

faq.a: South Delta Exchange, at 56 Street and 18 Avenue beside South Delta Recreation Centre, is served by routes including 601 to Bridgeport Station and 602 to Tsawwassen Heights and Bridgeport Station.
faq.q: Where do buses leave from in central Tsawwassen?

faq.a: Highway 17 south leads to the BC Ferries Vancouver (Tsawwassen) terminal in Delta; BC Ferries lists sailings from Tsawwassen to Swartz Bay (Victoria), Duke Point and Departure Bay (Nanaimo) and the Southern Gulf Islands.
